title: Could use stronger lower back support.
text:
Could use stronger lower back support.. Out of the past four office chairs I've used, this is definitely the best, but it still isn't perfect.
When I got the huge box at my front door, I was excited to get it assembled; my old chair had been losing the left arm, which had broken off some time ago but was kept in place by some duct tape. Assembling this chair was extremely easy, and it was set in my office in no more than ten minutes.

While this chair has more gizmos and levers than any previous chair I've owned (with the exception of a headrest, however), there is one huge flaw for me: the seat cushion doesn't recline as far backward as I'd like. The seat angles forward quite a bit, but it's almost flat when I recline it all the way backward. Also, the whole chair itself doesn't lower as much as I'd prefer, though it's got quite the height at its highest. I'm 5'8" if that matters.

The levers on the bottom right are very easy to reach. They put icons on them for ease of use, but I sometimes still find them confusing to interpret and have to maneuver them all to find the one for which I'm looking. For instance, to adjust the seat forward, there's a lever that has an image of a person sitting on the chair, with the chair highlighted in white. There are green lines to show what the lever does (green lines in front and in back of the chair, indicating it moves the back forward and backward), but there's green crossing into other areas of the chair which the lever does not control. It would've been best to just leave green and omit the rest, this way I would know that the lever controls that specific function.

The four levers, (three on the right and one on the left) control height, angle of the seat, seat glide, and the angle of the back.

Now, the back of the chair provides great support, though I wish it could lower just ever so slightly. Still, it's great, but I have noticed that over time it has loosened, so who knows how much longer it'll last at a tight angle.

All in all, this chair could be better. The fact that it doesn't angle more forward or provide a little lower adjustment make it slightly less comfortable for shorter people. At least it is for me. Otherwise, it's the better of the four office chairs I've owned and used.
